resources.string: Uses Android defaults with Standard Bluetooth routing and no transcription gain. The microphone remains available.
Tune each option independently. Entering Custom keeps the current values.
Changes apply to the NEXT recording. An active recording keeps its starting configuration, so these controls can stay editable.

Software gain affects transcription and its retries, not the original audio saved in history. Playback and export keep that original audio. Each saved microphone recording retains its own gain choice for retries; imported files use no gain.
NS: noise suppression. AEC: echo cancellation. AGC: automatic gain control. AGC_ONLY requests AGC on, NS and AEC off. Support varies by device; diagnostics report what Android actually applied.

STANDARD_SCO requests classic SCO. HFP_VOICE_RECOGNITION requests headset voice recognition. COMMUNICATION_DEVICE explicitly uses Android 12+ communication-device routing. Each route requests your selected audio mode; unsupported or unapplied choices show a Phone-fallback warning.
The selected Bluetooth routing API is unavailable on this Android version.
Android did not apply the selected Bluetooth audio mode.
Android did not confirm the selected phone microphone. Recording stopped; any captured audio is retained for recovery.
Android reported %1$d Hz, %2$d channels and PCM encoding %3$d. Recording requires 16000 Hz mono PCM16; no format substitution was made.
Requested microphone source %1$s, but Android reported source %2$d. Select another source explicitly to retry.
Android does not confirm UNPROCESSED source support on this device. Select another microphone source explicitly to retry.
Android did not report a usable microphone buffer. Capture could not be verified.
HFP needs Nearby devices access on Android 12 and later. Without it, Phone recording and file transcription remain usable. Your selected input and automatic Bluetooth preference are kept.

Nearby devices access was not granted. HFP is unavailable; Phone recording and file transcription remain usable. Your input and automatic preference are kept. Try granting access, or open App settings → Permissions → Nearby devices.
Nearby devices access granted. HFP still requires a compatible connected headset; diagnostics show the actual route.
Local technical details for the current or last recording, not a prediction of the next recording. Device addresses are redacted. Nothing is exported automatically.
Could not update microphone settings. Please try again.
